newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: SOCCER-LATE GOAL PUTS MOZAMBIQUE IN FINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE GOAL PUTS MOZAMBIQUE IN FINALS.

text.p: Mozambique qualified for the 1998 African Nations' Cup finals on Saturday by beating Malawi 2-1 with a dramatic late winner.
Manson Shabba Phire put Malawi ahead after 62 minutes but Pinto Barros equalised five minutes from time.
A draw would have sent Malawi through but with three minutes to play Tico Tico netted the winner.
It was only the second time -- the first was in 1986 -- that Mozambique have reached the finals.
